terrain:

Orthographic square-grid RPG camera looking down at 55 degrees, verticals upright, NO isometric diamonds. Consistent light from upper left. Each sprite must be fully inside its own cell. Absolutely no cast shadow outside cell.
Row 1: four opaque square FLOOR tiles, entire 384x384 cell filled to every edge, same quiet blue-grey worn stone slabs, edges all identical dark mortar 3px; subtle variations hairline crack, sparse moss corner, plain slabs, tiny ancient gold inlay. Floors muted, not bright.

Each wall uses SAME geometric footprint: core square from x96..288 y96..288, connecting arms exactly 192px wide reach corresponding cell edge. Low raised top cap with shallow dark visible south bevel contained within footprint. The connected arms must reach their cell edge and align exactly with neighbors. No plinth, no floor beneath wall. The 12 cells in reading order: horizontal east-west straight; vertical north-south straight; corner north-east; corner east-south; corner south-west; corner west-north; T north-east-west; T north-east-south; T east-south-west; T north-south-west; four-way cross; isolated central square pillar. Keep all surfaces and joints axis-aligned, not oblique. Large individually painted masonry, rich stone detail but restrained contrast. Real transparent alpha between wall arms, no checkered background. This is reusable technical sprite atlas, not a composed room.
doors:
